name: jquery-displayresolution
description: jQuery plugin that displays viewport/screen resolution, scroll position and browser dimensions in a floating copy-to-clipboard widget

scripts.build: terser jquery.displayresolution.js -o jquery.displayresolution.min.js -c -m --source-map url=jquery.displayresolution.min.js.map && node scripts/sync-docs.js
scripts.test: node test/smoke.test.js && node test/min.check.js && node test/demo.check.js
